title: What I learned working as a fuel attendant in Oman
author: Arafat Bin Wahahid
excerpt: Three years on the forecourt taught me a lot about safety, teamwork and customer service.

image.alt: Arafat on duty at a fuel pump

content.text: I joined Oman Oil Marketing Company in November 2023. Here is what the job has taught me so far.
HSE rules are not paperwork. They keep customers and the team safe, so I report problems early.
Teaching new attendants made me understand every procedure more deeply.
